verdict.rationale: Superhuman's own Auto Drafts 2.0 can pull from your calendar and "insert availability" into reply drafts. Users can also tell its scheduling features to "use this booking link." So availability-sharing into emails is evidenced, but only through AI-generated drafts. Calendar features such as Find Time and team scheduling show free time inside the app, not times inserted into an email. Missing for 10: a documented user-invoked command to insert availability or time slots into an email, native bookable meeting links rather than a user-supplied booking link, detail on how inserted availability looks to recipients, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
